description.mekexnihilo.electric_sieve: A Mekanism powered sieve. Install any Ex Deorum mesh to sift materials automatically; better meshes process more items per operation.
description.mekexnihilo.sieve_factory: The factory version of the Sieve Machine: runs several sieving operations in parallel every cycle, and has more input and output slots. Use a Mekanism tier installer on a Sieve Machine to build one, and higher tier installers to upgrade it further.
mekexnihilo.configuration.title: Sieve Machine settings
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.output: Output slots of the plain Sieve Machine. Each factory tier adds 'output slots per tier' on top. Break and replace a machine for a change to take effect.
Extra output slots granted per factory tier. At the default of 4 the five machine levels get 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 28.

How many items a single output slot may hold. Compressed sifting multiplies the yield heavily, so 64 is far too little. Mekanism stores such oversized stacks correctly, which is why this may exceed NeoForge's ceiling of 99. Range 64 - 8192.
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.inputS: Weakest first: Sieve Machine, Basic, Advanced, Elite and Ultimate Sieve Factory. Defaults to 1, 3, 4, 5, 8; each entry may be 1-12. Break and replace a machine for a change to take effect.
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.baseTi: Ticks required for one operation with no Efficiency on the mesh. 20 ticks = 1 second.
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.effici: Fraction of the processing time removed per level of Efficiency on the mesh. 0.05 means -5% per level, capped at 100% total (never below 1 tick).
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.fortun: Relative increase of the drop chance per level of Fortune on the mesh. 0.2 means +20% per level; allowed range 0.05 - 0.50.
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.energy: Energy consumed per tick while the machine is running.
Maximum energy the machine can store internally.
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.damage: Whether the installed mesh wears out like the vanilla sieve does. Disabled by default, so meshes last forever in the machine.
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.siftBy: Ex Deorum marks some sifting recipes as by_hand_only. Disabled, the machine skips them exactly like Ex Deorum's own Mechanical Sieve; enabled, the machine processes them too.
mekexnihilo.configuration.machine.respec: Enabled, Efficiency and Fortune are capped at their vanilla maximum level. Disabled (the default), levels above the cap keep stacking, because reaching the 100% processing-time reduction needs Efficiency 20 while the vanilla cap is V.
mekexnihilo.configuration.compressed.ena: Recognise AllTheCompressed items (allthecompressed:sand_1x .. sand_9x), sift them with the recipe of their base material and scale the result. On by default when AllTheCompressed is installed. That mod is not a dependency: with it absent this option does nothing.
mekexnihilo.configuration.compressed.com: A tier N compressed item yields base^N times the normal drops. At the default 2.0, sand_1x yields 2x and sand_3x yields 8x.
A tier N compressed item takes base^N times as long. Default 2.0.
A tier N compressed item draws base^N times the energy per tick. Default 2.0.
mekexnihilo.configuration.tiers.batchSiz: Items per operation by mesh tier
How many input items one operation consumes at each mesh tier, weakest first (string, flint, iron, golden, diamond, netherite). Defaults to 1, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64.
